notes: CDER Office of Compounding Quality and Compliance letter for a 503B outsourcing facility (Torrance, CA): insanitary sterile-compounding conditions (glove fingertip sampling performed after gloves were sanitized) plus CGMP violations (QC acceptance criteria, aseptic contamination-prevention procedures, environmental monitoring, equipment cleaning, component testing). No product name, redacted or otherwise, is ever stated -- the letter refers only generically to 'drug products' -- so products is empty and product_redacted is false rather than true. No FEI is stated in the letter (only the WL number).
